drivingQuestion: Which set counts when applied out of order?

segments.he: אָמַר אַבָּיֵי: אִידִי וְאִידִי שְׁנִיִּים עָלוּ לוֹ, וְלֹא רִאשׁוֹנִים, וּמַאי ״רִאשׁוֹנִים״? רִאשׁוֹנִים לִכְסִדְרָן, וּשְׁנִיִּים לְהַעֲבָרָתָן.
segments.en: «Abaye said» that there is no dispute between these two baraitot: Both «this» baraita «and that» baraita agree that the substances that he applied «second count for him, and not» the substances that he applied «first. And what» does the second baraita mean when it uses the term: «First?» It means the «first according to the order» of the mishna, which were the «second in their application.»

moves.about: both baraitot count what was applied second; 'first' means first in the mishna's order

moves.summary: 'First' in the order, second in application

edges.about: both baraitot count what was applied second; 'first' means first in the mishna's order

positions.claim: what was applied second counts; 'first' = first in the mishna's list
